answer: Mooring bond stops bulk fakes. Each agent claims one vertex on the mooring graph, locks 70 at a scarce anchor, pays 45. The prism ledger lists filings by key, anchor, epoch; one anchor holding two identities burns both. First fake pays 45, each later one 6 more; 1,000 cost 3,042,000, far above the 40,000 reward pool. A rented anchor stays keyed to its lender; a second filing on it forfeits both bonds. Honest agents pay 45 once and keep the bond.
